name: Shenyang Jinbei Automotive Company Limited
summary: Shenyang Jinbei Automotive Company Limited engages in the design, production, and sale of automotive parts in China. The company offers automotive interior parts, complete seats, lighting system components, battery components, and electric powertrain cooling system components. It also engages in industrial investment and property management activities. In addition, the company provides metallic materials and plastic parts. Shenyang Jinbei Automotive Company Limited was founded in 1984 and is based in Shenyang, China.
